description.value: The Aldergrove Community Centre is a large Township of Langley recreation facility featuring an aquatic complex with a wave pool, waterslides, diving boards, hot tub, and sauna, alongside an ice arena and fitness centre. Extensive accessibility infrastructure includes a portable aquatic lift and water wheelchair ramp into the social pool. A touring cyclist would find showers, change rooms, washrooms, and multiple food options within a single facility.

judgement.verdict_reason: Duplicate of the Aldergrove Credit Union Community Centre.

Showers (drop-in or fee).detail: Change rooms with handheld shower head explicitly listed in website amenities; facility admission likely required to access

Café or food on site.detail: Website lists 'food truck' under amenities and Triple O's (604-857-1514) as a leased tenant space within the building
